notes:
Product / Search lead: Jonah Patel (PL). Mid-market B2B SaaS: enterprise knowledge bases + marketplace search. Interested in Redwood rerank endpoint as a drop-in to current two-stage stack. Shorthand from last calls:
- Wants deterministic relevance signals for UI ranking + personalized boosts.
- POC: host 10k eval queries, top-100 candidates offline scored, compare baseline BM25+lambdaMART -> Redwood rerank.
- Latency target (live): p95 < 150ms for rerank call (they accept multi-call pipeline). Throughput target: sustained 150-250 QPS at peak.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for predictable pricing if Dedicated lowers per-token costs at scale.
- Security: SSO + SAML mandatory, audit logging for model decisions, KMS for any stored keys, explicit data residency reqs for EU customers.
- Quote from Jonah: "We need reproducible offline scoring and a way to pin a rerank model without rebuilding infra."
- Implementation notes: prefer hosted API for fast POC (no infra), then Dedicated if SLA/costs make sense. Ask: how does Redwood support large offline eval sets and masked/partial token billing for rerank-only workloads?
- Action items: A) Provide sample pricing scenarios for host vs dedicated (see drive pricing deck). B) Template for eval set upload and offline scoring job. C) Security questionnaire (SEC-1203) answers expected by 2026-03-12.
- Internal risks: product team wants deterministic seeds for reproducible ranking; engineering wary of cold-starts for KV cache on rerank flows.
- Notes: Sent sample eval CSV 2026-03-02 (drive link). POC budget tentatively approved up to $20k for hosted pilot.

use_case_summary: Two-stage search: fast retrieval (BM25) -> rerank candidates via model. Primary goal: improve relevance precision@10 and reduce false positives. Need offline scoring to generate features and tune rerank weights; want hosted POC then move to Dedicated for throughput and isolation.
